text: You thrive in the thick of battle, but your mystery's sheer focus on the physical and material leaves your soul weak against the tricks of spellcraft. You gain weakness 2 to any damage dealt by a spell.

You gain the Scrounger's Glee hex cantrip, and your familiar learns Enfeeble. When you Cast or Sustain a hex, your familiar can draw on the waning strength of another to sustain itself. One creature within 15 feet of your familiar with less than half of its maximum Hit Points becomes Sickened 1 unless it succeeds at a Fortitude saving throw against your spell DC.

text: Each lesson grants you a hex and teaches your familiar a new spell, adding it to the spells you can prepare using your witch spellcasting. You gain this spell even if it's not on your tradition's spell list.
